next_step: Finalize Dedicated sizing and reserved capacity pricing; finance call to agree commit level
notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market B2B product platform (customer onboarding + contextual chat + site search). Evaluating Hosted API for fast launch; leaning toward Dedicated after POC for predictable latency and cost control.

Discovery / context:
- Product team (API + Web) wants conversational assistant inside product and a semantic search index for docs. Key metrics: 95th pct latency target <= 200ms for short-chat turns, embeddings throughput ~20 qps for search refresh scenarios.
- High sensitivity to per-token and per-embed unit economics; finance flagged model cost as primary procurement blocker.
- Must meet EU data residency for subset of accounts (Germany), want VPC option for Dedicated.

Timeline & recent activity:
- 2025-01-15: Intro call (owner: Sofia). Demo of Hosted API basics. Notes: "love streaming & function-calls". Action: send pricing deck + latency bench. (ff_2025-01-22_7643)
- 2025-01-22: Cost optimization workshop (remote, 90m) run by Miguel + product infra. Covered batching strategies, KV/prefix caching, and quantization profile tradeoffs. Outcome: provisional savings estimates (~25-35% cost reduction) with aggressive prefix caching + 4-bit quant. (ff_2025-01-22_7643)
- 2025-01-30: Demo of Dedicated architecture and autoscale behavior. SE reviewed reserved capacity tiers. Raised question about client-managed KMS for EU data. (ff_2025-01-30_8821)
- 2025-02-01: POC kickoff — small sandbox using Hosted API with synthetic traffic; collect latency distribution and token counts. POC owner: Honeygrove infra lead (Jason Liu).
- 2025-02-05: Cost analysis update: baseline token cost for chat estimated at $0.018/token-equivalent; after batching + cache + 4-bit quant estimate drops to ~$0.012/token-equivalent. Need more runs to confirm quality delta on summarization prompts.

POC details / technical asks:
- Workload: mixed chat (context windows avg 800 tokens), search embeddings batch jobs (bulk index rebuilds overnight), reranking for top-k search.
- Targets: tail-latency SLO 200ms (95th) for interactive chat; offline index throughput not > 2x cost budget.
- Model preferences: open-models preferred (cost reasons) but they will consider Redwood-curated variants; want auto-fallback to cheaper quantized variant when Dedicated capacity constrained.
- Optimization levers discussed: dynamic batching, request-level prefix/KV caching, small-batch embedding aggregation, model quantization to 4-bit with eval harness, tokenization sanity checks.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must demonstrate SOC2 + audit logging; security team requested an excerpt of Redwood Console audit trails and KMS integration docs.
- Data residency: EU tenant required for 15% of customers — want region pinning and optional VPC routing.

Pricing / commercial:
- Finance expects committed discount if sign Reserved Dedicated for 12 months. They're modeling scenarios for 50% commit vs 25% commit.
- Estimated ARR range shared with prospect: $120k-$350k depending on commit size and add-ons (observability retention).

Quotes / direct feedback from prospect:
- "We need predictable monthly bills — burst credits are fine but not surprises at month end."
- "If we can see a clear 30%+ cost improvement in the POC while holding output quality, procurement will push for Dedicated."

Next steps (short):
- 2025-02-10: Finance-to-finance call scheduled to discuss commit tiers and discounting (owner: Sofia). (thread-CA+hg-20250203-finance)
- 2025-02-14: Dedicated sizing follow-up demo with infra and SE (Miguel to run).
- Deliverable: POC results summary (latency, cost per token, quality delta per prompt set) + a recommended reserved capacity plan and committed pricing option.

Blockers (current):
- Procurement wants external pen-test report + SOC2 evidence (SEC-4951).
- Concern about quantization quality for summarization edge-cases — product team requested side-by-side eval on 150 sample prompts.
- KMS integration details for client-managed keys in EU.

Quick CRM-style notes (shorthand):
- POC: active, sandbox tokens ~1.2M so far.
- Workshop: showed batching gains (reduce per-token CPU by ~18%).
- SE asks: capture peak daily token distribution to size cache layers.
- Action: share quantization eval harness and recommended prompt sets by 2025-02-07.
